minimumTables.name: analytics.forward_dqv_benchmark_ledger_v3
minimumTables.responsibility: Persist the immutable decision-time ledger header, enrollment, cutoff, population, model, benchmark, classification, and cost-policy roots.

minimumTables.name: analytics.forward_dqv_benchmark_family_v3
minimumTables.responsibility: Persist exactly the six frozen benchmark families and each family's terminal evidence state.

minimumTables.name: analytics.forward_dqv_benchmark_variant_v3
minimumTables.responsibility: Persist every sealed benchmark variant, including all dated sector ETF variants.

minimumTables.name: analytics.forward_dqv_benchmark_holding_v3
minimumTables.responsibility: Persist decision-time holding weights, notional, ADTV, cost, selection, price, action, and lineage.

minimumTables.name: analytics.forward_dqv_benchmark_variant_outcome_v3
minimumTables.responsibility: Persist each benchmark variant path and its portfolio-level gross, cost, net, and evidence roots.

minimumTables.name: analytics.forward_dqv_security_benchmark_binding_v3
minimumTables.responsibility: Bind every frozen security to exactly one variant for each benchmark kind, including its dated sector ETF.

minimumTables.name: analytics.forward_dqv_benchmark_holding_outcome_v3
minimumTables.responsibility: Persist each holding weight, notional, ADTV, gross contribution, nonlinear cost result, and evidence hash.

requiredSuccessorDesign.outcomeBatchHeaderRule: V18 forward_dqv_outcome_batch_v2 remains the maturity-run header and must reference the exact decision-time ledger.
requiredSuccessorDesign.portfolioCostRule: Evaluate liquidity-sensitive cost per holding, then divide the sum of holding notional multiplied by holding cost rate by total variant notional; never average ADTV or copy one holding cost to the portfolio.
requiredSuccessorDesign.portfolioReturnRule: Compute weighted holding returns for the selected variant.
requiredSuccessorDesign.sectorComparisonRule: Resolve the SECTOR variant from each security's sealed dated classification binding; never reuse one sector outcome for all securities.
